{{nowrap|[[To be determined|TBD]] 4-4 [[To be determined|TBD]]}} (5 October 2024) | updated = 21 May 2026 | prevseason = [[2025–26 Liga Primera|2025–26]] | nextseason = [[2027–28 Liga Primera|2027–28]] }} The '''2026–27 Liga Primera de Nicaragua''' football season was to be divided into two tournaments, Apertura and Clausura. The season will determine the 83rd and 84th champions in the history of the [[Liga Primera de Nicaragua]], the top division of [[association football|football]] in [[Nicaragua]]. The Apertura tournament is to be played in the second half of 2025, while the Clausura is to be played in the first half of 2026. ==Teams== === Team information === A total of ten teams contested the league, including nine sides from the [[2025–26 Liga Primera de Nicaragua|2025–26 Primera División]], and one side from the [[2025–26 Segunda División de Fútbol Nicaragüense|2025–26 Segunda División]]. Real Madriz finished last in the aggregate table and were relegated to the Segunda División.{{cite web|url=https://www.elsalvador.com/deportes/futbol/juan-sanchez-descenso-ocotal/1216207/2025/|title=Salvadoreno Juan Sanchez Y Ocotal Decienden en Nicaragua|trans-title=Salvadorian Juan Sanchez and Octoal descended in Nicaragua|language=es|date=1 May 2025|access-date=31 May 2025|website=Elsalvador.com}} The champions from the Segunda División, [[FC San Marcos|San Marcos FC]], were promoted in their place.{{cite web|url=https://canal6.com.ni/san-marcos-f-c-vuelve-a-liga-primera-tras-conquistar-el-ascenso/|title=San Marcos F.C. vuelve a Liga Primera tras conquistar el Ascensoa|trans-title=San Marcos F.C. Returns back to first division after winning promotion|language=es|date=11 May 2026|access-date=11 May 2026|website=canal6.com.ni}} The 9th place team in the aggregate table, [[UNAN Managua]], faced the second-place team from the Segunda División, Matiguás FC, in a playoff for a spot in the Primera División. [[UNAN Managua]] won 3–1 over two legs, meaning they remained in the Primera División.[ ] === Promotion and relegation === '''Promoted from Segunda División''' as of June, 2026. * Champions: [[FC San Marcos|San Marcos FC]] '''Relegated to Segunda División ''' as of June, 2026. * Last Place: [[Real Madriz FC|Real Madriz]] ===Personnel and kits=== {| class="wikitable sortable" style="text-align: left;" !
